implementation.note: The authenticated handler rejected stale session, tick and raw-value preconditions. A valid edit followed by fresh inspection succeeded on the paused map. The production panel displayed the selected entity and editable vital.

architecture.note: The authenticated local MCP command and the Studio panel delegate to the same paused native vital-edit operation. Both use the project, entity reference, epoch, tick and expected raw value guards.

native_api.note: The native vitals case exercised the simulation field owner, a valid HP update and unchanged HP after rejecting stale ticks, stale raw values, unsupported fields, invalid decimals and a dormant entity.

skill.note: The Studio UI skill documents this panel and its native ownership. Its documented web suite, type checks and production build ran, and the strict skill catalog audit found zero errors.

persistence.note: A real vital edit survived serialization and deserialization into a fresh GameCore simulation with equal checksums. The native panel separately demonstrated stale session and raw-value rejection.

graphs.note: This panel operates on the current hosted simulation. It does not own or edit a graph document.

performance.note: Twenty-five guarded edits in a paused native match took approximately 1 ms p95 and returned at most 116 bytes each. These are explicit operator requests. Measurements include the real WKWebView bridge at 1 ms clock resolution; the whole Studio host used 256540 KiB resident after sampling.
